title: Armored Dragon Knight
description: A towering humanoid dragon warrior in ornate black and gold armor stands on broken stone ruins, holding a glowing blue lightning sword. Massive white feathered wings spread wide behind him while a long dark dragon tail curls to the side, set against a stormy sky with lightning and another black dragon visible in the background.
prompt: A majestic dragon humanoid knight wearing intricate black and gold armor with red cape, glowing green eyes, standing powerfully on broken stone ruins. He holds a large sword crackling with blue lightning. Massive white feathered wings spread dramatically behind him, long scaled dragon tail visible. Dark stormy sky with lightning bolts, another black dragon roaring in the background, embers and sparks floating in the air, highly detailed fantasy scene
